subject: Post-call exec recap: AuroraMed - Leadership summary and procurement path
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: emily.stone@auroramed.com, mtorres@auroramed.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: Exec recap & next steps (AuroraMed)

Hi Emily / Michael —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap for your execs and our internal partners so we have alignment on the goals, risks, and procurement path. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Summary of what we heard
- Primary pain: inconsistent inference latency for clinician chat workflow (spikes at 95/99 PCTL causing dropped sessions).
- Secondary pain: rising unit cost across high-volume batch jobs and concerns about data residency and auditability for PHI workflows.
- Goal: pilot a production instance with 99th PCTL latency <200ms for chat, and target ~40% reduction in per-token cost through batching + quantization for batch jobs.

Business outcomes (exec view)
- Improve clinician response times and reduce dropped sessions to improve adoption metrics.
- Lower operating cost to make roadmap feasible for 2027 feature rollout.

Key risks / blockers
- Procurement & legal need SOC 2 evidence and a clear data residency plan.
- Integration with Epic workflows and EHR connectors needs a short technical runbook.
- Internal approval window: you mentioned leadership wants a decision by end of month (11/30).

Procurement path / next steps (proposed)
1) We will send a one-page exec summary + pricing sheet and SOW draft for their initial review (attached: AuroraMed_exec_recap.pdf, redwood_sla_and_pricing_v1.pdf).
2) Marissa (commercial lead) to follow up with a formal pricing proposal and optional discount tiers; Sean (solutions engineer) to schedule a 45-min leadership demo + technical deep dive for 11/22 or 11/23.
3) Procurement to confirm T&Cs and any required SOC 2 / compliance docs; we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and architecture whitepaper on demand.

Action items (who / when)
- Laura (me): send updated SOW + pricing by 11/21 EOD.
- Marissa: prepare pricing proposal and discount tiers for committed Dedicated capacity.
- Sean: prepare Epic integration runbook and demo deck; propose 11/22 10am PT for the leadership demo.
- AuroraMed procurement: review attached pricing + SOW and confirm availability for procurement call.

Attachments: AuroraMed_exec_recap.pdf, redwood_sla_and_pricing_v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the one-pager with your team.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: emily.stone@auroramed.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, mtorres@auroramed.com
Date: 2026-11-20T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Exec recap & next steps (AuroraMed)

Thanks Laura — this is helpful and accurate.

Two quick clarifications for the execs:
- Decision timeline: yes, leadership is aiming for a go/no-go by 11/30 so we can include this in the Q4 contracting window.
- Integration priority: Epic EHR integration is a hard requirement for the pilot (clinician workflow). Please make sure Sean's runbook addresses authentication and PHI handling.

I can join the leadership demo on 11/22 if that works.

Best,
Emily
Dr. Emily Stone
VP, Digital Health | AuroraMed
emily.stone@auroramed.com

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-20T18:10:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: AuroraMed pricing / discount ask

Laura / Sean —

Nice recap, Laura. A couple commercial notes and a proposed approach on pricing so we can meet their 11/30 window:

Pricing proposal (draft)\- Base: Hosted + Dedicated pilot pricing as outlined in redwood_sla_and_pricing_v1.pdf.
- Proposal: Offer a one-year committed Dedicated capacity with a 15% first-year discount if they sign an annual commit within 30 days.
- Upsell: Offer 20% discount for a 2-year commit (if legal agrees to longer term).

Approvals / escalation\- If AuroraMed asks for >20% discount or custom SLA changes, we escalate to VP Sales for approval (cc: me to loop in).
- If procurement requires unusual indemnity revisions, loop Legal — we should flag early.

Technical / compliance prep\- Sean: please prepare the Epic auth/PHI handling doc and include a short summary slide for the leadership demo.

Next steps (internal)
1) Marissa: finalize pricing worksheet and SOW draft, send to Laura for review by 11/21 noon PT.
2) Laura: send updated SOW + pricing to AuroraMed by 11/21 EOD.
3) Sean: technical demo + runbook ready by 11/22 9am PT.

Attachments for internal review: SOW_draft_v2.docx, AuroraMed_Pricing_Proposal.xlsx

I'll be on the 11/22 demo to lead commercial questions.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-21T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Updated: SOW + pricing & next steps (AuroraMed)

Emily / Michael —

Following up with the requested materials and confirmed next steps. Please find attached: SOW_draft_v2.docx and AuroraMed_Pricing_Proposal.xlsx. Key points:

- Commercial: we proposed a 15% first-year discount for a 1-year Dedicated commit (see pricing file). Marissa will walk through options during the demo.
- Technical: Sean will run through the Epic integration approach and PHI handling during the technical deep dive.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II and architecture whitepaper are available on request (link above).
- Timeline: proposed leadership demo 11/22 10:00 AM PT (we'll send a calendar invite). Procurement confirmed availability to review SOW the week of 11/23; please let us know preferred time.

Escalation items to flag for execs
- Any request for >20% discount or custom indemnity needs VP Sales/Legal sign-off.
- If Epic integration uncovers additional engineering work beyond the pilot scope, we may need to include a scoped implementation SOW.

Requested asks for AuroraMed
- Procurement: please confirm whether standard Redwood T&Cs are acceptable or whether you need redlines; if redlines are required, provide a highlighted doc by 11/24 so we can route to Legal.
- Leadership: confirm the 11/22 10am PT slot for the demo.

I'll be available if you want to run through the one-pager ahead of the demo. Looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
